_meta._note: Chapter 30 review (ch30-l07, new, display order 6). An unseen four-step text (events, doers, pronouns ـهَا / بِهِ back to their nouns), dialogue repair, relative مَا, and Al-Kafirun recognition. Carries the job of the proposal's unbuilt transfer lesson. Rebuilt 2026-10-02 in the proposal harvest (Docs/proposals/proposal-harvest-tracker.md) from Docs/proposals/chapter-30-content-proposal.md and its review amendments: reading across sentences (pronoun back to its noun, وَ / فَ in context), following a short story, following a dialogue with a clarification, relative مَا ('what') with the whole clause as the thing not worshipped, and the one complete reading of Al-Kafirun 109:1–6. Removed: أَجَابَ under root ء-ج-ب (it is ج-و-ب), 'both words are definite' for الْكِتَابُ جَدِيدٌ, the إِنَّ-sentence called verbal, لَكُمْ / لِي called possessives, and the 'complete surah' lesson that skipped 109:3. The proposal's separate unseen-text lesson (l06) was not built; its job is in the review.

text.ar: ذَهَبَتْ مَرْيَمُ إِلَى السُّوقِ مَعَ أُمِّهَا، فَأَعْطَتْهَا أُمُّهَا قَلَمًا جَدِيدًا. وَرَجَعَتْ مَرْيَمُ إِلَى الْبَيْتِ، فَكَتَبَتْ بِهِ الدَّرْسَ.
text.ar_plain: ذهبت مريم إلى السوق مع أمها، فأعطتها أمها قلما جديدا. ورجعت مريم إلى البيت، فكتبت به الدرس.
text.translit: dhahabat maryamu ilā s-sūqi maʿa ummihā, fa-aʿṭathā ummuhā qalaman jadīdan. wa-rajaʿat maryamu ilā l-bayti, fa-katabat bihi d-darsa.
text.en: Maryam went to the market with her mother, and her mother gave her a new pen. Maryam went back home and wrote the lesson with it.
text.ur: مریم اپنی والدہ کے ساتھ بازار گئی، اور اس کی والدہ نے اسے ایک نیا قلم دیا۔ مریم گھر واپس آئی، اور اس سے سبق لکھا۔
